```{r}
shift = read.csv("Bucknell_ShiftMed_Data_File.csv", header = TRUE) #read in file
library(tidyverse)  #both libraries that are useful... tidyverse includes dplyr and ggplot
library(patchwork)
#top 5 nurse msas
popfocus = c("Philadelphia-Wilmington-Atlantic City PA-NJ-DE-MD CMSA", "Washington-Baltimore DC-MD-VA-WV CMSA", "Pittsburgh PA MSA", "St. Louis MO-IL MSA", "New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island NY-NJ-CT-PA")
#type 5 nurse types
typefocus = c("CNA","LPN","RN","GNA","STNA")
#forming shiftfocus: subset of shift with the top 5 msas and top 5 nurse types
smallshift = shift[shift$nurse_type %in% typefocus, ]
shiftfocus = smallshift[smallshift$nurse_msa %in% popfocus, ]
#shiftfocus = shiftfocus[shiftfocus$worker_status != "TERMINATED", ]

#shiftworkers: subset of shift with only nurses who have worked at least one shift
shiftworkers = shift[shift$shifts_worked > 0, ]

#shiftfocusworkers: combination of both shiftfocus and shiftworkers
shiftfocusworkers = shiftfocus[shiftfocus$shifts_worked > 0, ]

#below: various variables for each subset
#ogshowrate: original measure of show rate described by stakeholders
#newshowrate: new measure of show rate described by stakeholders
shift$ogshowrate = shift$shifts_worked / shift$total_shifts_claimed
shift$newshowrate = shift$shifts_worked / (shift$shifts_worked + shift$shifts_call_out)

shiftfocus$ogshowrate = shiftfocus$shifts_worked / shiftfocus$total_shifts_claimed
shiftfocus$newshowrate = shiftfocus$shifts_worked / (shiftfocus$shifts_worked + shiftfocus$shifts_call_out)

shiftworkers$ogshowrate = shiftworkers$shifts_worked / shiftworkers$total_shifts_claimed
shiftworkers$newshowrate = shiftworkers$shifts_worked / (shiftworkers$shifts_worked + shiftworkers$shifts_call_out)

shiftfocusworkers$ogshowrate = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked / shiftfocusworkers$total_shifts_claimed
shiftfocusworkers$newshowrate = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked / (shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_call_out)

#wshiftratio: guaranteed shifts worked / total shifts worked 
#cancelratio: total shifts cancelled by nurse / shifts cancelled by facility
#new cancel ratio calculation: if number is inf (positive amount of shifts cancelled and 0 
#fac cancelled shifts), calculation will just go to the the total amount of shifts cancelled by
#the nurse. If the cancel ratio comes out to 0 AND there are 0 fac cancelled shifts (case where 0/0) #there will be an NA since it is not useful for them to be measured
shift$wshiftratio = shift$guaranteed_shifts_worked / shift$shifts_worked
shift$cancelratio = (shift$shifts_call_out + shift$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shift$shifts_unscheduled) / shift$fac_cancelled_shift 
shift$cancelratio[is.infinite(shift$cancelratio)] = shift$shifts_call_out + shift$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shift$shifts_unscheduled
shift$cancelratio[shift$cancelratio == 0 & shift$fac_cancelled_shift == 0] = NA

shiftfocus$wshiftratio = shiftfocus$guaranteed_shifts_worked / shiftfocus$shifts_worked
shiftfocus$cancelratio = (shiftfocus$shifts_call_out + shiftfocus$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocus$shifts_unscheduled) / shiftfocus$fac_cancelled_shift
shiftfocus$cancelratio[is.infinite(shiftfocus$cancelratio)] = shiftfocus$shifts_call_out + shiftfocus$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocus$shifts_unscheduled
shiftfocus$cancelratio[shiftfocus$cancelratio == 0 & shiftfocus$fac_cancelled_shift == 0] = NA

shiftworkers$wshiftratio = shiftworkers$guaranteed_shifts_worked / shiftworkers$shifts_worked
shiftworkers$cancelratio = (shiftworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftworkers$shifts_unscheduled) / shiftworkers$fac_cancelled_shift
shiftworkers$cancelratio[is.infinite(shiftworkers$cancelratio)] = shiftworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftworkers$shifts_unscheduled
shiftworkers$cancelratio[shiftworkers$cancelratio == 0 & shiftworkers$fac_cancelled_shift == 0] = NA

shiftfocusworkers$wshiftratio = shiftfocusworkers$guaranteed_shifts_worked / shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked
shiftfocusworkers$cancelratio = (shiftfocusworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_unscheduled) / shiftfocusworkers$fac_cancelled_shift
shiftfocusworkers$cancelratio[is.infinite(shiftfocusworkers$cancelratio)] = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_unscheduled
shiftfocusworkers$cancelratio[shiftfocusworkers$cancelratio == 0 & shiftfocusworkers$fac_cancelled_shift == 0] = NA

#totalcancel: total shifts cancelled by the nurses 
shift$totalcancel = shift$shifts_call_out + shiftworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shift$shifts_unscheduled
shiftfocus$totalcancel = shiftfocus$shifts_call_out + shiftfocus$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocus$shifts_unscheduled
shiftworkers$totalcancel = shiftworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftworkers$shifts_unscheduled
shiftfocusworkers$totalcancel = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_call_out + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_unscheduled

#termination: Boolean, marks whether nurse was terminated or not 
shift$termination = shift$worker_status == "TERMINATED"
shiftfocus$termination = shiftfocus$worker_status == "TERMINATED"
shiftworkers$termination = shiftworkers$worker_status == "TERMINATED"
shiftfocusworkers$termination = shiftfocusworkers$worker_status == "TERMINATED"
```
